# aemetools

aemetools is designed to work with
[AEME](https://github.com/limnotrack/AEME/). It contains a range of
functions to assist in setting up simulations for a lake site.

## Development

This package was developed by [LimnoTrack](http://limnotrack.com/) as
part of the [Lake Ecosystem Research New Zealand Modelling
Platform](https://limnotrack.shinyapps.io/LERNZmp/) (LERNZmp) project.
[![LimnoTrack
website](reference/figures/limnotrack_border.jpg)](http://limnotrack.com/)

## Overview

Currently, this package can be used to:

- Download meteorological data from
  [ERA5-Land](https://www.ecmwf.int/en/era5-land) for any point in New
  Zealand from 1980-2023, or download ERA5-Land GRIB files for any area
  in the world.
- Set up and run hydrological simulations using the suite of models from
  the [`airGR`](https://hydrogr.github.io/airGR/) package using
  catchment, reach and lake data.
- Conduct a sensitivity analysis on the parameters for the AEME models.
- Calibrate the AEME models using lake observational data.

## Installation

You can install the development version of aemetools from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("limnotrack/aemetools")
```

``` r
library(aemetools)
```

### Download NZ point meteorological data

Currently, there is ERA5-Land data (~9km grid spacing) archived for New
Zealand (166.5/-46.6/178.6/-34.5) for the time period 1980-2023 with the
main meteorological variables (air temperature, dewpoint temperature,
wind u-vector at 10m, wind v-vector at 10m, total precipitation,
snowfall, surface level pressure, downwelling shortwave radiation,
downwelling longwave radiation) required to drive hydrological and
hydrodynamic models. This can be easily downloaded using the example
below. There is a `parallel` switch which allows you to use multiple
cores on your computer to speed up the download.

``` r

lon <- 176.2717
lat <- -38.079
vars <- c("MET_tmpair", "MET_pprain")

met <- get_era5_land_point_nz(lat = lat, lon = lon, years = 2020:2021,
                      vars = vars)
summary(met)
#>       Date              MET_tmpair       MET_pprain      
#>  Min.   :2020-01-01   Min.   : 4.848   Min.   : 0.00000  
#>  1st Qu.:2020-07-01   1st Qu.: 9.699   1st Qu.: 0.08205  
#>  Median :2020-12-31   Median :12.729   Median : 0.83960  
#>  Mean   :2020-12-31   Mean   :12.845   Mean   : 5.10542  
#>  3rd Qu.:2021-07-01   3rd Qu.:15.782   3rd Qu.: 5.73165  
#>  Max.   :2021-12-31   Max.   :22.176   Max.   :53.44960
```

``` r

library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

met |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(MET_tmpair, MET_pprain)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = Date, y = value)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~name, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  theme_bw()
```

![](reference/figures/README-plot-era5-1.png)

# Package index

## All functions

- [`add_linz_key()`](https://limnotrack.github.io/aemetools/reference/add_linz_key.md)
  : Add LINZ API key to environment variables
- [`api_request()`](https://limnotrack.github.io/aemetools/reference/api_request.md)
  : Request data from the LERNZMP API
- [`calib_aeme()`](https://limnotrack.github.io/aemetools/reference/calib_aeme.md)
  : Calibrate AEME model parameters using observations
- [`calib_GR()`](https://limnotrack.github.io/aemetools/reference/calib_GR.md)
  : Calibrate GR model
- [`check_api_status()`](https://limnotrack.github.io/aemetools/reference/check_api_status.md)
  : Check API status
- [`convert_era5_ncdf()`](https://limnotrack.github.io/aemetools/reference/convert_era5_ncdf.md)
  : Convert ERA5 netCDF files to AEME or LER
- [`create_control()`](https://limnotrack.github.io/aemetools/reference/create_control.md)
  : Create control list for calibration or sensitivity analysis
- [`create_linz_key()`](https://limnotrack.github.io/aemetools/reference/create_linz_key.md)
  : Create LINZ API key
- [`download_era5_grib()`](https://limnotrack.github.io/aemetools/reference/download_era5_grib.md)
  : Download ERA5 GRIB files
- [`era5_ref_table`](https://limnotrack.github.io/aemetools/reference/era5_ref_table.md)
  : ERA5 reference table
- [`get_aeme()`](https://limnotrack.github.io/aemetools/reference/get_aeme.md)
  : Get Aeme object from LimnoTrack API
- [`get_catchment_data()`](https://limnotrack.github.io/aemetools/reference/get_catchment_data.md)
  : Get Catchment Data
- [`get_dem_raster()`](https://limnotrack.github.io/aemetools/reference/get_dem_raster.md)
  : Get DEM raster from LINZ
- [`get_dem_value()`](https://limnotrack.github.io/aemetools/reference/get_dem_value.md)
  : Get DEM value for a given latitude and longitude
- [`get_era5_isimip_point()`](https://limnotrack.github.io/aemetools/reference/get_era5_isimip_point.md)
  : Get ERA5 data from ISIMIP3a for a point location
- [`get_era5_land_point_nz()`](https://limnotrack.github.io/aemetools/reference/get_era5_land_point_nz.md)
  : Get ERA5 data for a coordinate
- [`get_lake_shape()`](https://limnotrack.github.io/aemetools/reference/get_lake_shape.md)
  : Get lake shape as sf object
- [`get_layer_ids()`](https://limnotrack.github.io/aemetools/reference/get_layer_ids.md)
  : Get layer IDs for a given spatial object
- [`get_linz_basemap_tile()`](https://limnotrack.github.io/aemetools/reference/get_linz_basemap_tile.md)
  : Get LINZ basemap tile
- [`get_param()`](https://limnotrack.github.io/aemetools/reference/get_param.md)
  : Get parameter values from calibration results
- [`get_raster_layer_value()`](https://limnotrack.github.io/aemetools/reference/get_raster_layer_value.md)
  : Get raster layer value for a given latitude and longitude
- [`get_raster_tile()`](https://limnotrack.github.io/aemetools/reference/get_raster_tile.md)
  : Get a raster tile from LINZ
- [`get_simulation_time()`](https://limnotrack.github.io/aemetools/reference/get_simulation_time.md)
  : Get simulation time for each model
- [`get_upstream_rec()`](https://limnotrack.github.io/aemetools/reference/get_upstream_rec.md)
  : Get all upstream reaches
- [`get_wlevel()`](https://limnotrack.github.io/aemetools/reference/get_wlevel.md)
  : Get modelled water level
- [`make_GR_inputs()`](https://limnotrack.github.io/aemetools/reference/make_GR_inputs.md)
  : Make inputs for the GR models
- [`nz_aerial_imagery_metadata`](https://limnotrack.github.io/aemetools/reference/nz_aerial_imagery_metadata.md)
  : sf object of aerial imagery metadata for New Zealand.
- [`nz_dem_metadata`](https://limnotrack.github.io/aemetools/reference/nz_dem_metadata.md)
  : sf object of Digital Elevation Model (DEM) metadata for New Zealand.
- [`plot_calib()`](https://limnotrack.github.io/aemetools/reference/plot_calib.md)
  : Plot calibration results
- [`plot_calib_summary()`](https://limnotrack.github.io/aemetools/reference/plot_calib_summary.md)
  : Plot calibration results
- [`plot_ensemble()`](https://limnotrack.github.io/aemetools/reference/plot_ensemble.md)
  : Plot AEME ensemble output
- [`plot_multiscatter()`](https://limnotrack.github.io/aemetools/reference/plot_multiscatter.md)
  : Plot multiscatter of the parameters against each other
- [`plot_scatter()`](https://limnotrack.github.io/aemetools/reference/plot_scatter.md)
  : Plot the scatter of the output of a sensitivity analysis
- [`plot_sobol()`](https://limnotrack.github.io/aemetools/reference/plot_sobol.md)
  : Visualization of first, total, second, third and fourth-order Sobol'
  indices
- [`plot_uncertainty()`](https://limnotrack.github.io/aemetools/reference/plot_uncertainty.md)
  : Plot the uncertainty of the output of a sensitivity analysis
- [`query_elev()`](https://limnotrack.github.io/aemetools/reference/query_elev.md)
  : Query elevation data for a shape within a DEM raster
- [`read_calib_meta()`](https://limnotrack.github.io/aemetools/reference/read_calib_meta.md)
  : Read the calibration metadata
- [`read_grib_point()`](https://limnotrack.github.io/aemetools/reference/read_grib_point.md)
  : Read a point from a grib file
- [`read_sa()`](https://limnotrack.github.io/aemetools/reference/read_sa.md)
  : Read sensitivity analysis output
- [`read_simulation_meta()`](https://limnotrack.github.io/aemetools/reference/read_simulation_meta.md)
  : Read the simulation metadata
- [`read_simulation_output()`](https://limnotrack.github.io/aemetools/reference/read_simulation_output.md)
  [`read_calib()`](https://limnotrack.github.io/aemetools/reference/read_simulation_output.md)
  : Read calibration output
- [`read_web_sf()`](https://limnotrack.github.io/aemetools/reference/read_web_sf.md)
  : Read spatial feature (sf) data from online databases as sf object
- [`read_web_table()`](https://limnotrack.github.io/aemetools/reference/read_web_table.md)
  : Read table data from online databases as sf object
- [`run_aeme_ensemble()`](https://limnotrack.github.io/aemetools/reference/run_aeme_ensemble.md)
  : Run AEME ensemble
- [`run_aeme_param()`](https://limnotrack.github.io/aemetools/reference/run_aeme_param.md)
  : Run AEME with parameter dataframe
- [`run_aeme_shiny()`](https://limnotrack.github.io/aemetools/reference/run_aeme_shiny.md)
  : Run AEME in a Shiny app
- [`run_and_fit()`](https://limnotrack.github.io/aemetools/reference/run_and_fit.md)
  : Run a model and calculate model fit.
- [`run_GR()`](https://limnotrack.github.io/aemetools/reference/run_GR.md)
  : Run GR model
- [`sa_aeme()`](https://limnotrack.github.io/aemetools/reference/sa_aeme.md)
  : Run sensitivity analysis on AEME model parameters
- [`set_weights()`](https://limnotrack.github.io/aemetools/reference/set_weights.md)
  : Set weights for simulated variables
- [`update_param()`](https://limnotrack.github.io/aemetools/reference/update_param.md)
  : Update parameter values in param based on best_pars
- [`write_csv_to_db()`](https://limnotrack.github.io/aemetools/reference/write_csv_to_db.md)
  : Write calibration/sensitivity analysis .csv files to database
